global: The truce with {faction} was signed in the council hall, not on a battlefield. That is how civilised lords settle matters.
I did warn that the war was costing us more than any reward could repay. Peace with {faction} is a relief, if a late one.
{my_faction} has made terms with {faction}. Let no one claim we did not weigh every harm before accepting.
Some will mourn the battles we did not win. I mourn the coin we wasted on them, and I shall say so at the next sitting.
The next vote in council should prove far livelier than any siege. I have already drafted my remarks.
Who drafted the clauses with {faction}? The answer is in the minutes, for anyone who cares to read them.
Ser, I hear the taverns are calling this a defeat. Curious, since {faction} now owes us a favour in writing.
Blood is spent and the treaty with {faction} is only ink now. Ink, I find, outlasts grudges by a wide margin.
